name: GopherForge: Go Workbench
subtitle: Code, test & learn offline
description:
Build, test and run stock Go on your iPhone or iPad, even offline. Go 1.27.1, the compiler, linker, vet and gofmt are bundled, so your code is built on your device.

CODE AND BUILD
• Edit Go and go.mod with syntax highlighting, completion and Go keyboard shortcuts.
• Build, Run, Test, Vet and Format; read Go diagnostics at their line and column, and see per-case test results.
• Use an app-scoped terminal for project and Go commands.
• Organize projects with folders, tags, favorites and search by file name.
• Import a public GitHub repository, a folder from Files or an exported archive.
• Resolve pure-Go packages through the official proxy and checksum database, then vendor their source for offline builds.

LEARN AND PRACTICE
• 47 lessons across nine units, plus 22 prediction challenges: core Go, structs, collections, interfaces, errors, concurrency, the standard library, modules and generics.
• Every lesson and challenge includes a topic-specific visual guide, practical context, common pitfalls and a link to the official Go reference.
• Highlighted examples and inline code. Embedded code scrolls with the lesson; expand code to scroll and edit it in full screen.
• Compiler-judged exercises, quizzes, matching drills and a review queue based on your mistakes.
• Idiom Coach explains common non-idiomatic patterns; Concurrency Lab runs channel and coordination scenarios.
• Runnable examples include PNG graphics and local HTML, CSS and JavaScript previews served on 127.0.0.1.

ADAPTS TO YOUR SCREEN
On iPad, keep files, code and a result dock visible together. On iPhone, switch full-height workspace panes. On supported iPhone Duo systems, the workspace follows the fold. In laptop posture, Code or Terminal stays above the hinge; tabs and keyboard helpers sit below it. Problems, Output, Tests and Idioms replace the lower keyboard. A Projects back button stays reachable while typing.

PRIVACY AND PURCHASE
A one-time paid download. No subscription, app account, analytics or advertising trackers. Projects and progress are local. Files stored with a chosen iCloud or other provider follow that provider's syncing behavior. Network requests happen for repository/package imports and external links; local web previews may load remote resources included by your project.

LIMITS
cgo is not supported. Compiled Go runs in a bounded WebAssembly sandbox with one writable project directory and no network access. The terminal is app-scoped. Website previews use WebKit rather than an unrestricted Go web server.
